name: workflow
description: List, inspect, select, run, or inspect the state of user-authored workflow DAGs. Workflow execution uses the same durable Session control path as the CLI and direct server requests.

action.description: list: discover workflows (default); info: inspect one graph; select: persist one workflow selection; run: execute one workflow; state: read durable selection/run state

expected_revision.description: Optional 64-character compiler revision fence for select/run

inputs.description: Values for the Workflow's declared input keys (action=run)

run.description: Optional stable Workflow run id for direct idempotent retries
